product_one_liner.value: SnapLogic is an agentic integration platform for enterprises that connects applications, data, APIs, and AI agents across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its Agentic Integration and Applied AI Platform as serving the enterprise and connecting these systems across deployment environments.

pricing_page.notes: SnapLogic has a public pricing page describing Essential, Professional, and Enterprise One packages.

named_customers.notes: All three names appear among the customer logos on SnapLogic’s customer page.

employee_band.notes: SnapLogic’s LinkedIn company profile gives the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: SnapLogic’s company profile identifies its headquarters in San Mateo, California, United States.

founded_year.notes: The company overview states that SnapLogic was founded in 2006.

eng_blog.notes: The technical/data-engineering post describes SnapLogic analytics architecture using S3 and Trino; a separate test-automation post describes provisioning full SnapLogic environments and is attributed to a QA Lead.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site links to multiple product areas and articles, including API Management, AutoSync, Public APIs, Admin Manager, and AgentCreator.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: SnapLogic’s live Lever listing is titled Applied AI Architect.

model_provider.value: SnapGPT supports publicly available LLMs and identifies AWS Bedrock; SnapLogic’s subprocessor list also names Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Azure OpenAI for AI data processing.
model_provider.notes: The public materials identify multiple supported/provider relationships rather than a single exclusive model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The page names SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA-HITECH certifications and states GDPR compliance. ISO 27001 is mentioned as an AWS infrastructure capability, not as a SnapLogic platform certification.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists a completed Debt - General transaction dated August 13, 2025, but does not disclose its amount; 0 is the schema-required neutral placeholder, not a reported amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The recorded completed Debt - General transaction is dated August 13, 2025, which falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026; the record does not disclose an amount.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Lever posting is for a Sales Development Representative EMEA.

launched_6mo.notes: SnapLogic announced new Agentic Integration Platform capabilities on October 20, 2026, within the six-month window ending November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 12, 2026, SnapLogic announced Molly Matthews as President and executive promotions to Chief Customer Officer and Chief People Officer, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: SnapLogic postings mention Salesforce for prospect/lead management and list Salesforce CRM, Marketo, and Outreach as required knowledge for a field-marketing role; these are job-posting stack signals.
